label: Projekte
research: Linear: projects as a list/board with a project page (properties edited in place in a right rail: status, lead, dates; progress; the project's issues as list/board), issues open as a panel with title + description edited in place, properties as rows that save on pick, sub-issues, comments + activity below; 'My issues' is the personal default view, a create row at the top of a list (type + Enter), keyboard first. Asana/Notion boards: one column per status, '+' at the bottom of a column creates in place; on phones one column fills the screen and you swipe sideways (Asana) or pick a column from chips. Things/Todoist 'Today/My tasks': grouped by due (Überfällig · Heute · Diese Woche · Später · Ohne Datum), quick add with Enter, ticking off in place. Taken: project page per patterns.md §8 (Stats, Eigenschaften inline, description autosaves), task panel with in-place title/description and property rows that save on change, Aufgaben with Meine · Alle and grouping by status / due, a quick add row (Enter, stays in the list), the board as one column at a time with snap + column chips on phones, trash for tasks with restore.
